title: Trinity uses nmap in The Matrix Reloaded
summary: A very short clip from The Matrix Reloaded in which Trinity runs nmap and then uses an SSH exploit. The scene is notable for showing a real tool.
why: HN points to it as a rare Hollywood hacking scene that uses real tools and a plausible, era-appropriate exploit.

quote.text: The Matrix Reloaded features Trinity correctly using nmap to find an exposed SSH server
